crossRefs.note: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of…
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
“You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
translations.asv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, ye are gods?
